description: Implementation of the MidiMessageQueue class handling MIDI message queuing, parsing, and processing.

classes.name: MidiMessageQueue
classes.description: A class managing a queue of MIDI messages, supporting addition, retrieval, and parsing of MIDI data.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds MIDI data to the queue, either from a vector or raw pointer.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a complete MIDI message from the queue, handling SysEx and real-time messages.
